mail.example.com {
    # gryonixnexus: mailcow
    @gryonixnexus_open path /SOGo/dav /SOGo/dav/* /.well-known/caldav /.well-known/carddav /principals /principals/* /Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync /Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync/*
    @gryonixnexus_portal path /admin /admin/* /domainadmin /domainadmin/* /rspamd /rspamd/*
    handle @gryonixnexus_open {
        reverse_proxy https://127.0.0.1:18443 {
            header_up Host {host}
            transport http {
                tls_insecure_skip_verify
            }
        }
    }
    handle @gryonixnexus_portal {
        import /etc/caddy/gryonixnexus-admin-guard
        forward_auth 127.0.0.1:8094 {
            uri /api/authz/forward-auth
            copy_headers Remote-User Remote-Groups Remote-Name Remote-Email
        }
        reverse_proxy https://127.0.0.1:18443 {
            header_up Host {host}
            transport http {
                tls_insecure_skip_verify
            }
        }
    }
    handle {
        import /etc/caddy/gryonixnexus-admin-guard
        reverse_proxy https://127.0.0.1:18443 {
            header_up Host {host}
            transport http {
                tls_insecure_skip_verify
            }
        }
    }
}
